1-1.title: Legs

exercises.name: Lying leg curls
exercises.instructions: Have someone gently push down on your lower back while you do these to keep your hips down — you won’t be able to go as heavy, but it will isolate them better. Two warm up sets then 1 set of 12, go heavier, 1 set of 10, heavier, 1 set of 8, rest about 30 seconds between sets. Then do a drop set like this for your 4th set: go back to weight you did for 12, do 10 reps, drop a plate and do 10 more reps, drop a plate and do 10 reps, then do 25 partials out of the bottom. Just start the weight up and come back down... little reps... your hams will be on fire... the weight will literally only be moving 2-3 inches, but they will be on fire from the constant tension.

exercises.name: Barbell stiff legs
exercises.instructions: Barbell stiff legs (bend your knees at bottom) — use 25 lb plates (on the barbell) to get better stretch — 2 warm ups to get stretched out then find a good weight that you can use for 3 sets of 10. On every rep come up and flex your glutes and hams. 3 total work sets.

exercises.name: Leg press
exercises.instructions: Leg presses — you will love leg presses after all this ham work. Place feet just a little wider than shoulder width, and a little low on the platform. Start light with 1 plate on each side. When you are going heavy, you should still keep feeling it in your hamstrings. Keep going up for sets of 10 until you can get to a weight you are able to work hard. Once you get to what you feel is your first working set (where you are getting 10, but starting to have to work hard), I want you to take 3 seconds going down during the eccentric phase, then drive the weight up on EVERY REP throughout the remainder of your leg presses. I want you to do 3 hard sets of this. Go up in weight as much as you like, just be sure to get the full 3 second descent on each and every rep. Do not lock out — keep constant tension on your thighs for the best effect.

exercises.name: Smith machine squat
exercises.instructions: Smith machine squat — you will be plenty warm — this won’t take much weight — have one of the guys there who is a constant tension. So 2 sets of 10 done like this — go down below parallel, and only come up 3/4 of the way up — then back down deep the way up — that is one rep. So really they are 1 1/2’s. These will be 2 total work sets.

exercises.name: Leg extension
exercises.instructions: Leg extension — I want you to raise your butt out of the seat when you are doing these. It will allow you to squeeze your tear drop harder — 1 x 12, and hold each contraction for 3 seconds. Use a heavy weight and squeeze the crap out of them. 1 total work set.

1-1.source_note: The original Week 1.1 sheet contains the Legs session. The next source sheet begins Back and then Chest; source pages are not equivalent to workout days.

1-2.title: Back
1-2.source_note: Back session appears on Week 1.2 source sheet, followed by the start of Chest. Prescribed total: 13 work sets.

exercises.name: Meadows rows
exercises.instructions: 2 warm up sets then 3 x 10. This is a modified one-arm bar row. On a regular T-bar, grasp the little bar that sticks out where you load the weights and face across the machine. Take your left hand and grab the bar with an overhand grip, brace with your right hand on your right knee, and move your hips around slightly to create the best possible lat stretch. The sheet describes this as a hard movement that will leave you breathing heavily.

exercises.name: Cable rows
exercises.instructions: Use two separate handles attached beside each other. It is the same as a regular low-row attachment, except you can pull back an inch or two further, creating a much better contraction. 3 x 15. 3 total work sets.

exercises.name: Dumbbell pullovers
exercises.instructions: 3 x 12. The original sheet references a technique video: lie with your head off the end of the bench, along it rather than across it. Watch the technique. 3 total work sets.

exercises.name: Narrow-grip chins
exercises.instructions: 2 sets to failure. Work hard on arching your chest and stretching at the bottom. These will be extremely hard after the other work. If needed, use an assisted machine or have a spotter help. 2 total work sets.

exercises.name: Dumbbell shrugs
exercises.instructions: Hold the dumbbells for 3 seconds at the top of EVERY rep. Do 1 x 12. 1 total work set.

exercises.name: Hyperextensions
exercises.instructions: Hold a dumbbell against your chest (the sheet says the author uses a 40) and do 1 set to failure, then drop the weight and continue with bodyweight to failure. 1 total set.

exercises.name: Flat dumbbell twist press
exercises.instructions: Excellent for pre-exhaust. Lay flat on bench with dumbbells, lower them and arch your chest so that you get a good stretch at the bottom. Turn your palms so that they are facing each other. This will allow the fibers on your inner pecs to stretch much more. Now when you drive the weight up, as you drive turn your pinkies in and squeeze at the top. You cannot do as much weight as a regular dumbbell press, but you will get a great contraction once you find a good weight. Do 3 sets of 10. There is video of this on my website under the training/chest tab, and also on my YouTube channel. 3 total work sets.

exercises.name: Barbell incline
exercises.instructions: 2 warm sets of 8, then pyramid doing sets of 8. For example, I do something like 225, 250, 275, 315 etc. Keep going up until you can't get 8, then stop. You should get to this point in about 4 sets. 4 total work sets.

exercises.name: Stretch pushups
exercises.instructions: Place two flat benches beside each other or, if you have them, 2 aerobic step-up benches raised. You are going to get in the middle and do a modified pushup. Sink down in the middle really low to get an awesome stretch. Keep your chin up. Don't let your lower back sway; your feet will be on the ground. Stretch really well at the bottom, and drive up and squeeze. Use a fairly wide grip so you can really open your chest up. 3 sets of 20. You should have a sick pump at this point. I have video of this on my website and YouTube channel using raised aerobic step benches as the primary means of delivering the stretch. This exercise will greatly help your flexibility. 3 total work sets.

exercises.name: Dumbbell bent over laterals
exercises.instructions: 3 sets of 20 here after 1 warm up. I am a huge believer in training rear delts. You will notice in the weeks to come I do some unusual rep ranges on rear delts. Be prepared. 3 total work sets.

exercises.name: Barbell front raise
exercises.instructions: Grab a barbell with a grip outside shoulder width (kind of wide) and raise out in front of your front delts. Go all the way up to over your head. 3 sets of 12. Your shoulders should be on fire at this point. 3 total work sets.

exercises.name: Dumbbell side lateral partial raises
exercises.instructions: Grab very heavy dumbbells, tilt your head back, and just sort of swing them out with straight arms to the side. You will only come up about a 1/3 of the way. These are heavy partials. Heavy partials for high reps on these will blast your side delts. 3 sets of 30. 3 total work sets.

exercises.name: EZ bar curl
exercises.instructions: 3 sets of 15 light to warm up – grab a moderate weight. Do 10 perfect reps and set weight down. Count to 10, and repeat. Do 5 sets total – so 5 sets of 10 with 10 second breaks. The last 2 sets should have your arms screaming. 5 total work sets.

exercises.name: Hammer curls
exercises.instructions: Same thing – 5 sets of 10 with 10 second breaks. On these I actually took the dumbbells to my ears (I did them both at same time) and flexed as hard as I could. 5 total work sets.

exercises.name: EZ bar preacher curls
exercises.instructions: Can't use a ton of weight on these – 2 sets of 10. I do these real slow on the eccentric phase. I don't like dropping these at bottom for fear of bicep injury...so don't be afraid to use moderate weight. I let my arms straighten very gently, and curl up with deliberate form. 2 total work sets.

exercises.name: Rope pushdowns
exercises.instructions: 2 sets of 12 to warm up – then first-set 3 times: Rope pushdowns for 15 → Dips between benches (I know, old school) with 45 or 25 pound (depending on how strong you are) plates on lap for 10 → dumbbell pronated kickbacks heavy for 6 reps – kick up hard and contract. Look at my YouTube or website for video on how to do it pronated. 9 total work sets via 3 rounds.

exercises.name: Dips between benches
exercises.instructions: Superset with rope pushdowns and dumbbell pronated kickbacks for 3 rounds; use 45 or 25 pound plates on lap depending on strength.

exercises.name: Dumbbell pronated kickbacks
exercises.instructions: Superset with rope pushdowns and dips between benches for 3 rounds; heavy for 6 reps, kick up hard and contract.

exercises.name: Skull crushers / lying extensions
exercises.instructions: Keep elbows in, and stretch at bottom real good. 2 total work sets.

exercises.name: Overhead dumbbell extensions
exercises.instructions: Using one dumbbell, perform sets of 8 in a superset with skull crushers/lying extensions for 2 rounds. The source states 4 total work sets across the two exercises.

exercises.name: Toe presses on leg press
exercises.instructions: I want you to do 3 timed 1 minute sets of these. Stretch your calves good at the bottom, and when you can't plantar flex your foot all the way and flex your calf, just do small partials out of stretched position. Use a weight that will allow you to get at least 15 reps with a full range of motion. 3 total work sets.

exercises.name: Lower abdominal exercise (choose one)
exercises.instructions: Choose one: Hanging Leg Raises; Leg raises with elbows supported on pad; Leg raises on a decline board/bench; V ups. Pick one exercise from the following to hit lower abs: Hanging Leg Raises; Leg raises with your elbows supported on pad; Leg raises on a decline board/bench; V ups. Pick one exercise from the following to hit upper abs: Incline sit ups; Rope pulldowns/crunches; Band crunches. For abs – these will always be simple. You will pick an exercise from the first list and do 4 sets of 15-25 reps depending on how hard they are. Next you will pick an exercise from the upper ab list, and do the same. Each ab workout will be 8 sets.

exercises.name: Upper abdominal exercise (choose one)
exercises.instructions: Choose one: Incline sit ups; Rope pulldowns/crunches; Band crunches. Pick one exercise from the following to hit lower abs: Hanging Leg Raises; Leg raises with your elbows supported on pad; Leg raises on a decline board/bench; V ups. Pick one exercise from the following to hit upper abs: Incline sit ups; Rope pulldowns/crunches; Band crunches. For abs – these will always be simple. You will pick an exercise from the first list and do 4 sets of 15-25 reps depending on how hard they are. Next you will pick an exercise from the upper ab list, and do the same. Each ab workout will be 8 sets.

2-1.title: Legs
2-1.notes: Low to moderate volume; 13 working sets as listed in source heading. Perform a 30-second quad stretch between leg press and hack squat sets, increasing intensity as blood flow increases.

exercises.name: Seated leg curls
exercises.instructions:
Warm-up: 2 warm-up sets of 20

Find a weight that is hard for 14 reps, using a full range of motion all the way up and back. Do 14 reps; rest 1 minute. Add a plate and do 12 reps; rest 1 minute. Add another plate and do 10 reps. Return to a weight 1 or 2 plates lighter than the starting weight and perform 35 reps. The first 10 should feel easy; finish the entire set, using partials for the last 10 if necessary.

exercises.name: Leg extension
exercises.instructions:
Warm-up: As many warm-up sets as needed to feel comfortable

Work up to a weight you can do for 10 reps. Perform 2 sets of 10, holding and squeezing for 2 seconds at the top. If your butt comes out of the seat, it will make the teardrop work harder.

exercises.name: Leg press in a machine
exercises.instructions:
Warm-up: 2 warm-up sets

Warm up with a standard shoulder-width stance, toes pointed straight up and medium placement on the platform. Focus on the lower part of the movement and the teardrop. Add a plate and perform 10 reps until reaching a weight normally good for 10–12 reps maximum. With that weight do 3 sets of 16, using your hands to assist if necessary. Continuous tension, no locking out. Rest about 3–4 minutes between working sets.

exercises.name: Hack squats
exercises.instructions:
Warm-up: 1 slow warm-up set

Warm up slowly all the way to rock bottom. Work up to a weight allowing 8 reps rock bottom. Descend all the way and pause under control; drive up without locking out. Your legs should be extremely pumped after the two sets.

exercises.name: Dumbbell stiff-leg deadlifts
exercises.instructions: Do not come all the way up; bend the knees slightly at the bottom and focus on getting a good stretch. Try to get deeper each set, pushing the hips back as you descend and keeping the dumbbell right against you.

2-2.title: Back
2-2.notes: 14 sets listed in source heading. The dumbbell row begins on page 2.1; remaining back exercises continue on 2.2.

exercises.name: Dumbbell row deadstops
exercises.instructions:
Warm-up: Several warm-up sets

Perform a normal dumbbell row, but let the dumbbell rest on the ground before driving the elbow up as hard as possible. Do several warm-up sets to ensure you can drive your elbow up hard. Pyramid up 3 × 12, about 30 lb heavier each set. Stay controlled, especially on the way down.

exercises.name: Cable rows
exercises.instructions: Standard low cable row with a 2-second pause in contraction. On odd reps 1, 3, 5, 7 and 9, lean forward to stretch the lower lats, contract and hold for 2 seconds. On even reps 2, 4, 6, 8 and 10, keep your back totally straight and arms straight before contracting. Flex hard during each hold.

exercises.name: Barbell row in Smith machine (overhand grip)
exercises.instructions: Pull relatively high toward the upper abs to target rhomboids and traps. Hold and flex at the top for 2 seconds. Use the same weight for all three sets, with strict form rather than swinging a heavy barbell.

exercises.name: Dumbbell pullovers
exercises.instructions: Rest the arms from rowing and keep stretching the lats. Pull only to the top of the forehead, then lower. Lie lengthwise on the bench with the head hanging off its end, rather than across the bench, to allow a comfortable stretch. Return only to forehead level.

exercises.name: Barbell shrugs
exercises.instructions: Perform higher-rep shrugs this week and focus on the burn.

exercises.name: Hyperextensions holding a moderately heavy dumbbell
exercises.instructions: Move slowly and concentrate on contracting the spinal erectors. Drop the dumbbell when exhausted and continue with bodyweight.

2-3.title: Chest & Shoulders
2-3.notes: Chest heading says 11 sets, but individual exercise totals sum to 12; shoulders 10 working sets. Source chest prescriptions contain some self-reported rep examples rather than fixed targets.

exercises.name: Flat dumbbell presses

sets.reps: 15, then increase weight each set; reps as achieved
15, then increase weight each set; reps as achieved
15, then increase weight each set; reps as achieved
15, then increase weight each set; reps as achieved

exercises.instructions:
Warm-up: 3 light warm-up sets

After light warm-ups, select a weight for a solid 15 reps. Use a normal traditional bench-press grip. Pause 1 second at the bottom and squeeze for 1 second at the top. Increase weight each set and record the reps achieved; source example was 15, 13, 11 and 9.

exercises.name: Decline dumbbell press
exercises.instructions: Use a slight decline rather than a steep angle. Keep elbows angled to avoid rotator strain. Find a good weight and aim for 4 sets of 10, squeezing at the top. The source example fatigued to 10, 10, 9, 8.

exercises.name: Incline dumbbell press
exercises.instructions: Use a good weight for 3 sets. Maintain a 1-second stretch at the bottom but do not squeeze at the top; keep continuous tension and do not come up all the way.

exercises.name: Cable crossovers
exercises.instructions: Stretch hard and bring the arms close to the flex position, but not quite all the way. Maintain continuous tension for a strong pump.

exercises.name: Heavy side laterals
exercises.instructions: Bring dumbbells to ear level. Rest only 30 seconds between sets. Heavy laterals with low reps and short rests should produce a deep dull burn.

exercises.name: Bent-over rear laterals (cable machine)
exercises.instructions: Use the cable machine this week. Barely move the arms while the rear delts burn. Higher repetitions, controlled movement, and accumulating pump are emphasized.

2-4.title: Arms, Calves & Abs
2-4.notes: Triceps 13 sets, biceps 9 sets, calves 5 sets, abs 8 sets. Triceps begins on 2.3, continues on 2.4; calves continue onto 2.5. For abdominal work select one option from each list rather than doing all options.

exercises.name: Rope pushdowns
exercises.instructions:
Group: Triceps tri-set — 3 rounds

Warm-up: 2 warm-up rounds with light weight

Flex at the bottom for 1 second. Perform as the first exercise in a three-exercise tri-set.

exercises.name: Pronated dumbbell kickbacks
exercises.instructions:
Group: Triceps tri-set — 3 rounds

Warm-up: 2 warm-up rounds with light weight

Turn palms to face upward toward the ceiling at peak contraction to emphasize the inner/long head. Strong peak contraction; perform second in the tri-set.

exercises.name: Dips between benches
exercises.instructions:
Group: Triceps tri-set — 3 rounds

Warm-up: 2 warm-up rounds with light weight

At the top, flex and sit back on the triceps for 1 second. The source reports about 6–10 reps and says added plates should not be necessary. Perform third in the tri-set. After three rounds, rest a few minutes before the next exercise.

exercises.name: Incline triceps extensions with dumbbells
exercises.instructions: Use a relatively light weight. Let the dumbbells move slightly out to the sides while lowering so they do not hit the bench. Seek a good stretch at the bottom.

exercises.name: EZ bar curls
exercises.instructions:
Warm-up: 2 warm-up sets of 20

Do 2 warm-up sets of 20 reps. Then 10 strict reps, rest 1 minute and do another 10. The third set is an 842 rest-pause: 8 reps, rest 10 seconds, 4 reps, rest 5 seconds, 2 reps. Avoid swinging and focus on a roughly 2-second negative during the final mini-sets.

exercises.name: EZ bar preacher curls
exercises.instructions: Keep the movement strict as fatigue increases. Do two sets of 10 followed by an 842 rest-pause set (8 reps, 10-second rest, 4 reps, 5-second rest, 2 reps).

exercises.name: Hammer curls
exercises.instructions: Perform 10 reps, add 5 lb to the dumbbells for another 10 reps, add 5 lb again, and finish with an 842 rest-pause set. Focus on a slow negative, especially in the 842 set.

exercises.name: Standing calf raises
exercises.instructions:
Warm-up: 1 warm-up set of 30; pyramid sets before work sets

Warm up for 30 reps, then pyramid upward from 15 reps until only 10 are possible. Do 3 sets of 10 at that weight. Reduce the weight for the final set of 20. Flex at the top and stretch at the bottom for 3 seconds. For the final set, avoid descending all the way and use half reps. Finish with four 30-second stretches for each calf.

exercises.name: Seated calf raise
exercises.instructions: One all-out extended set: choose a weight for 15 reps, reduce weight for 10 reps, reduce again for 20 mini-partials from the bottom. Flex at the top and stretch at the bottom; do not pause at the bottom, keep the reps moving.

exercises.name: Lower abs — choose one exercise
exercises.instructions: Choose ONE: hanging leg raises; leg raises with elbows supported on pad; leg raises on a decline board/bench; V-ups. Do 4 sets of 15–25 depending on difficulty.

exercises.name: Upper abs — choose one exercise
exercises.instructions: Choose ONE: incline sit-ups; rope pulldowns/crunches; band crunches. Do 4 sets of 15–25 depending on difficulty.

exercises.name: Lying leg curls
exercises.instructions: Two warm-up sets of 15. Put heels together as best you can throughout each set to target inner hamstrings; keep feet together through the middle range, stay strict. Three working sets of 15.

exercises.name: Leg extensions (pre-exhaust)
exercises.instructions: Two warm-up sets of 25. Set 1: 20 reps, hold and flex at top for 2 seconds; rest 90 seconds. Set 2: 12 reps with 3-second hold and flex. Set 3: 6 reps with 5-second hold and squeeze. Increase weight substantially each set. After final set, stretch quads for 20 seconds between subsequent sets.

exercises.name: Squats
exercises.instructions: Feet slightly wider than shoulder width and toes slightly out. Go just below parallel. Pyramid up in weight but keep 10 reps per set. Perform three hard working sets, maintaining perfect form; after the pre-exhaustion, keep the weight controlled.

exercises.name: Leg press
exercises.instructions: Feet close together at middle of platform; keep butt on pad. Do 30 reps, increase weight for 20, then increase weight for 15. Go deep, emphasize teardrop, pump without locking out.

3-2.title: Back
3-2.notes: Original sheet labels 14 sets; individual prescriptions total 14 (3+3+2+3+3).

exercises.name: Smith machine bent-over rows (overhand grip)
exercises.instructions: Two warm-up sets of 15. Hold bar at belly button for a second and flex lats. First working set 15; rest two minutes, hard set 12; final set use weight suitable for 8 normal reps, lower weight and do 6 more reps (14 total).

exercises.name: One-arm cable rows
exercises.instructions: Use single attachment; do 8 on one side then 8 on the other. At the bottom lean forward and stretch lower lats; as you come up, arch, squeeze lats and drive elbow back as far as possible. Three working sets.

exercises.name: Rack deadlifts
exercises.instructions: Use a fairly heavy weight (roughly a 4–6-rep weight). Do 10 rest-pause reps, resting 10 seconds between each single rep; last 3–4 should be grueling. If weight is too light after 10, add 5 more. Perfect form. Original counts this as two working sets.

exercises.name: Dumbbell pullovers on bench
exercises.instructions: Three sets of 12 using new form lying along the bench, not across it.

exercises.name: Partial chins
exercises.instructions: Hang from bar. Perform 3 sets of 15 partials: rise only about one-third of the way, approximately 4–5 inches. Relax scapulae at bottom and stretch; do not pull all the way up. Traps get a break this week. Use wrist straps on rows/pulls except pullovers.

exercises.name: Machine flyes / pec deck flyes
exercises.instructions: Two warm-up sets of 20. Choose machine allowing nearly straight arms. Lower for 3 seconds, contract and hold 1 second. Three sets of 12, adding some weight each set. Spotter may assist last few reps while maintaining movement and form.

exercises.name: Barbell incline bench
exercises.instructions: One or two warm-up sets. Three sets of 8 with constant tension; stop about two inches short of chest and do not lock out.

exercises.name: Flat bench dumbbell press
exercises.instructions: Raise one end of flat bench slightly using a 25-lb plate to open up middle chest. Three sets of 8, hold and flex hard at top for one second each rep.

exercises.name: Flat bench barbell press
exercises.instructions: Three sets of 6 with rest pause. Lower slowly, touch chest, pause two seconds, then drive up hard. Use light enough weight after chest pre-exhaustion.

exercises.name: Side laterals
exercises.instructions: Warm up with one set of side laterals. Working sets: 12 reps, 10 reps, then 8 reps followed by 10 seconds rest + 4 reps, 5 seconds rest + 2 reps (the 842 set).

exercises.name: Dumbbell rear delt raises (hang and swings)
exercises.instructions: Face down on incline bench with pad at chest so arms can hang together at bottom. Use fairly heavy dumbbells; rather than pulling all the way up, swing straight arms about six inches. Three sets of 30 swings.

exercises.name: Dumbbell front raises
exercises.instructions: Raise both dumbbells together to about two inches above eye level; lower slowly. Three sets of 12.

3-4.title: Arms, Calves & Abs
3-4.notes: Triceps 12 tri-set rounds + 3 skullcrusher sets; original heading says triceps 12, which omits the skullcrushers. Biceps 10; calves 8; abs 8 (twice this week).

exercises.name: Rope triceps pushdowns (tri-set A)
exercises.instructions: Warm up with 3 sets of 15 rope pushdowns, plus one set of dips between benches and one set of rope extensions. For working tri-set, do 12 rope pushdowns, immediately followed by bent-over rope extensions and bench dips; rest 90 seconds between rounds. Four rounds total.

exercises.name: Bent-over rope extensions (tri-set B)
exercises.instructions: Immediately after rope pushdowns, do 10 bent-over rope extensions, emphasizing deep stretch; then move straight to bench dips.

exercises.name: Dips between benches (tri-set C)
exercises.instructions: Immediately after bent-over rope extensions, do bench dips to failure, going low and briefly sitting back on the bench to contract triceps. Rest 90 seconds after each full tri-set; four rounds.

exercises.name: Lying skullcrushers
exercises.instructions: Finish with three sets of 10 once elbows are warm. Set 1 lower toward forehead; set 2 lower behind head; set 3 lower farther behind head for deeper stretch.

exercises.name: EZ bar curls (tri-set A)
exercises.instructions: Warm up with EZ bar curls. Working tri-set: 8 controlled EZ bar curls, flex hard at top, then immediately standing dumbbell curls and reverse EZ bar curls.

exercises.name: Standing dumbbell curls (tri-set B)
exercises.instructions: Both arms together, palms up throughout; lower on a two-second count. Immediately after EZ bar curls, before reverse curls.

exercises.name: EZ bar reverse curls (tri-set C)
exercises.instructions: Eight reps for brachialis and brachioradialis. Complete three total tri-set cycles.

exercises.name: Close-grip chin-ups (biceps)
exercises.instructions: One final working set; palms up, close grip, try for eight reps. Avoid using back and focus on biceps.

exercises.name: Standing machine calf raises
exercises.instructions: Two warm-up sets of 20. Eight sets of 8 with 60-second breaks. Stretch at bottom without bouncing; progressively heavy but complete all reps. Stretch calves afterward.

exercises.name: Lower abdominal exercise — choose one
exercises.instructions: Choose one: hanging leg raises; leg raises with elbows supported on pad; decline-board leg raises; or V-ups. Four sets of 15–25 depending on difficulty.

exercises.name: Upper abdominal exercise — choose one
exercises.instructions: Choose one: incline sit-ups; rope pulldown crunches; or band crunches. Four sets of 15–25. Perform this eight-set abdominal workout twice during the week.

4-1.title: Legs
4-1.notes: Phase 2 begins in Week 4; moderate-to-high volume. Source specifies 16 total working sets.

exercises.name: Seated leg curls
exercises.instructions: Two warm-up sets of 15. Choose a challenging weight for three sets of 10, using rest-pause: fully extend legs, pause for one second, then curl and squeeze. Rest about 90 seconds. Fourth working set is an extended drop set: slightly heavier than the 10-rep sets, do 6 reps with 3-second negatives and a pause at the bottom; drop ~20 lb for 6 more, drop ~20 lb for another 6, then one last drop for 15 very hard reps.

exercises.name: Squats
exercises.instructions: Warm up with 3 sets of 10, then work up to a weight allowing five solid reps and complete five working sets of five. Squat just below parallel, descend slowly and deliberately, drive up hard, keep every rep strict and avoid sloppy/grinding reps. Focus on total heavy-volume with perfect form.

exercises.name: Barbell walking lunges
exercises.instructions: Use an empty barbell; take 12 steps/paces with each leg. If there is not enough room to walk, use a Smith machine. On each lunge, let the back knee gently touch the ground and pause for one second; bring trailing leg up alongside lead foot to remove momentum, then switch legs. Move down slowly and drive back up. Three working sets.

exercises.name: Dumbbell stiff-leg deadlifts
exercises.instructions: Four sets of 12. Keep legs slightly bent, push hips backward, move slowly and strictly, maintain continuous hamstring tension, and do not lock out at the top.

4-2.title: Chest & Shoulders
4-2.notes: Pre-exhaust chest with a superset before pressing. Original sheet gives no explicit total chest/shoulder header at top of page.

exercises.name: Cable crossovers (superset A)
exercises.instructions: Superset with modified dumbbell flyes for four rounds. Pull handles across the middle of the torso, not too low, to activate the middle chest. Flex and hold one second at the bottom. Twelve reps each round.

exercises.name: Modified dumbbell flyes (superset B)
exercises.instructions: Immediately after each cable crossover set, do seven modified flyes. Emphasize a deep stretch and an arched chest with sternum lifted. On the upward phase, only raise arms to approximately the 10 o’clock and 2 o’clock positions, then lower again to keep constant tension. Four supersets total.

exercises.name: Incline barbell bench press
exercises.instructions: Do a few preparatory sets until reaching a weight you would normally use for eight reps. Perform four sets of six with a three-second lowering phase; drive upward only three-quarters of the way and immediately lower again. Focus on the pecs controlling the eccentric.

exercises.name: Barbell bench press (paused)
exercises.instructions: Four working sets of five. Lower the bar, pause two seconds, then explode upward. Pyramid up by roughly 30–40 lb jumps until the fifth rep is challenging. Emphasize speed and controlled paused reps.

exercises.name: Side laterals
exercises.instructions: Each working set is three clusters of eight: do eight lateral raises, put the weights down for ten seconds, do eight more, rest ten seconds, then do eight more. You may need assistance to finish the final eight. Three working sets.

exercises.name: Machine shoulder press
exercises.instructions: Choose a weight that is hard for ten full reps. Hold and flex for two seconds at the top of each of the first ten reps; immediately perform ten more half reps from the bottom. Three working sets.

exercises.name: Rear delts on pec deck / flye machine
exercises.instructions: Two sets of 40 reps. Hold and squeeze every rep at the fully contracted position.

4-3.title: Back
4-3.notes: Source heading specifies 16 total back sets; individual exercises sum to 16. First exercise starts at bottom of page 4.2 and continues at top of 4.3.

exercises.name: Single-arm cable rows
exercises.instructions: After two warm-up sets, select a weight that is hard for 12 reps, then add weight for 10 and again for 8. Drive the elbow far back and contract hard enough to feel a strong cramp-like squeeze. Stretch lower lats at the extended position. Three work sets.

exercises.name: Rack deadlifts
exercises.instructions: With lower lats pre-exhausted, work up in weight by adding plates. As you ramp, use sets of six and focus on strict negatives through the lower lats. Finish at a weight where three reps are very difficult. Set bar around kneecap level or slightly higher, take a deep breath on the rack, and pull hard. Source counts the final three ramping sets as working sets.
exercises.technique: ramp to heavy triple; 3 counted working sets

exercises.name: Lat pulldowns with assisted stretch
exercises.instructions: Use a spotter if available. Pull in front and squeeze for one second at the bottom. As you begin the negative, the partner presses gently on the stack to increase tension, then adds gradual resistance near full stretch; tension must stay smooth. Without a partner, use a hard controlled negative. Three sets of ten.

exercises.name: Supported rows
exercises.instructions: Use a chest pad and neutral bench-press-like grip. Keep elbows up, squeeze the middle of the back hard, and stretch at the bottom. Three sets of twelve.

exercises.name: Dumbbell shrugs
exercises.instructions: Use heavy dumbbells. Do ten reps with a three-second squeeze at the top, rest 45 seconds, then perform more reps to failure; rest 30 seconds, then perform as many more as possible without the three-second top hold. That sequence is one working set; repeat twice.

exercises.name: Hyperextensions
exercises.instructions: Hold a moderately heavy dumbbell and perform 15 reps, then drop the dumbbell and do at least ten more bodyweight reps. Two sets.

4-4.title: Arms, Calves & Abs
4-4.notes: Page 4.5 duplicates the visible content of page 4.4. Abdominal section calls for eight sets twice during the week, but does not specify reps or distribution across the two chosen movements; these are recorded as a selectable prescription, not fabricated exercise reps.

exercises.name: Dips between benches (superset A)
exercises.instructions: After two warm-up sets, superset bench dips with one-arm incline dumbbell extensions. Perform 20 bench dips, adding weight if possible, then immediately do 8 one-arm dumbbell extensions. Four rounds.
exercises.technique: superset with one-arm incline dumbbell extensions

exercises.name: One-arm incline dumbbell extensions (superset B)
exercises.instructions: Sit on an incline utility bench. Use one dumbbell, lower it across the face while keeping upper arm and elbow pointing upward; keep movement strict. Do all eight reps on one arm, then the other, after the bench dips. Four supersets.
exercises.technique: 8 per arm; superset with bench dips

exercises.name: Close-grip bench press
exercises.instructions: One warm-up set. Three sets of eight with a three-second negative. Choose a comfortable EZ bar or straight bar; lower under control to emphasize the triceps stretch. Keep a strong triceps focus.

exercises.name: Rope pushdowns
exercises.instructions: Three heavy sets of eight, flexing hard at the bottom. Stretch triceps frequently after they become pumped.

exercises.name: EZ-bar curls
exercises.instructions: Two warm-up sets. Pyramid up in weight for sets of 12, 10, and 8. Lower for two seconds, squeeze hard on every rep, and rest about one minute between sets.

exercises.name: Dumbbell curls (palms-up phase)
exercises.instructions: Three rounds: perform eight curls with palms facing up throughout, taking three seconds on the lowering phase, then immediately flip the wrists for eight hammer-style curls.

exercises.name: Dumbbell hammer curls (same-round continuation)
exercises.instructions: Immediately after eight palms-up curls, perform eight hammer curls. Repeat this two-part sequence for three rounds. The source counts six working sets total across the two phases.

exercises.name: Preacher curls (heavy partials)
exercises.instructions: Four sets of six heavy partial reps, working the middle and top of the range. Flex hard at the top of each rep.

exercises.name: Standing machine calf raises
exercises.instructions: Two warm-up sets of twenty. Pyramid to a weight that allows about ten full-range reps. Each working set: ten full-range reps followed immediately by five partials out of the bottom. Rest two minutes between sets.

exercises.name: Seated calf raises
exercises.instructions: Three sets of twenty-five reps.

exercises.name: Lower-ab exercise — choose one
exercises.instructions: Choose one lower-ab movement: hanging leg raises; supported elbow-pad leg raises; decline bench/board leg raises; or V-ups. Source specifies eight total abdominal sets twice this week, but does not specify rep counts or allocation between lower and upper abs. Four sets here are a provisional equal split for app tracking, NOT an explicit prescription.

exercises.name: Upper-ab exercise — choose one
exercises.instructions: Choose one upper-ab movement: incline sit-ups, rope pulldown/crunches, or band crunches. Source specifies eight total abdominal sets twice this week without rep counts or allocation. Four sets here are a provisional equal split for app tracking, NOT an explicit prescription.

5-1.title: Legs
5-1.notes: Source heading: 17 sets; 4+3+4+4+2=17. Leg-extension/lunge superset is 2 rounds counted as 4 exercise sets.

exercises.name: Seated leg curls
exercises.instructions: Two warm-up sets of 15. Three hard sets of 12 with continuous tension and a squeeze. Final set: same weight for 10 with 3-second negatives; drop weight for 8 more, drop again for another 8. Stretch hamstrings for 30 seconds per leg afterward.

exercises.name: Leg press
exercises.instructions: Warm up by increasing weight in sets of 10. First hard set: 15 reps with 3-second descent, drive up without locking out. Second: same weight for 15. Third: same weight for 12 with 3-second negatives; drop for 10 with 3-second negatives; drop for 8 with 3-second negatives; drop again and use normal-speed deep reps for an intense teardrop stretch. Stretch quads 30 seconds.

exercises.name: Smith machine squats
exercises.instructions: One warm-up set. Toes turned far out and stance slightly wider than shoulders; squat very deep, come only halfway up. Increase weight for sets of 15, 12, 10, and 8. Keep back straight and form perfect. Stretch quads for 45 seconds afterward.

exercises.name: Leg extensions + heavy dumbbell lunges
exercises.instructions: Two rounds of a superset. On leg extensions, perform 8 reps with a 2-second squeeze at the top; immediately do 6 slow, controlled lunging paces with each leg using a heavy dumbbell. The source calls this 4 total working sets (2 rounds). Stretch quads 60 seconds.
exercises.technique: 2 supersets; 8 extensions + 6 lunges each leg per round

exercises.name: Hyperextensions or glute/ham raise
exercises.instructions: Position body away from pad, almost on tiptoes, to emphasize glutes and hamstrings. Hold dumbbell and squeeze hard at top for 15. Second set: 15 weighted reps, then drop weight for 10 bodyweight reps. Stretch hamstrings 45 seconds.

5-2.title: Chest & Shoulders
5-2.notes: Source: chest 16 sets and shoulders 8. Rear delts are 2 giant sets despite six tracked rep segments.

exercises.name: Incline dumbbell press
exercises.instructions: Pyramid up through four sets of 8. Stretch well at bottom, drive to full lockout and squeeze. Increase weight until eight reps are challenging without sacrificing the squeeze.

exercises.name: Smith machine slight-decline press
exercises.instructions: Set a very slight decline. Lower only three-quarters of the way and keep continuous tension. Use light weight for 25, slightly heavier for 20, then heavier for 12 with perfect form. Fourth set: use a weight good for 8–10, go to technical failure, strip weight and repeat, then widen grip and strip again for further failure reps. Source gives illustrative plate combinations and about 10, 12–15, 20 reps on successive stages.
exercises.technique: final set extended drop to technical failure

exercises.name: Flat barbell bench press
exercises.instructions: Four rest-pause sets of 5: lower under control, rest bar on chest for two seconds, then drive explosively upward.

exercises.name: Cable crossover
exercises.instructions: Four sets of 6 with a very deep chest stretch. Do not prioritize the flex at the bottom; the stretched position is the focus after the heavy presses.

exercises.name: Smith machine seated overhead press
exercises.instructions: Lower to the top of the head, do not lock out, keep shortened range. Add weight across sets of 15, 12, 9; rest only about 60 seconds.

exercises.name: Overhead dumbbell press
exercises.instructions: Three sets of 10. Squeeze at the top and touch dumbbells together to complete the arc.

exercises.name: Bent-over rear-delt raises
exercises.instructions: Two extended rounds: 30 rear laterals, rest 30 seconds, 20 reps, rest 30 seconds, 10 reps; repeat once. The source counts these as 2 total working sets despite 6 rep segments.

5-3.title: Back
5-3.notes: Back begins at bottom of source page 5.2 and continues on 5.3. 6+3+6 chins+2=17 working sets.

exercises.name: Smith machine bent-over rows
exercises.instructions: Two or three warm-ups. Two strict sets of 8, then add weight for two rest-pause sets of 7, then add weight for two rest-pause sets of 6. Place stops around mid-shin, set bar down and pause each rep before driving explosively with lats.

exercises.name: Low cable row
exercises.instructions: Three progressively heavier sets of 10, 8, 6. Reach far forward and stretch lats, then sit upright, arch chest, and squeeze lats.

exercises.name: Chins — narrow grip
exercises.instructions: Use low-row attachment over bar. Each set aim for ~6 good reps, then have spotter assist 2 forced reps by pushing at shoulder blades.

exercises.name: Chins — medium overhand grip
exercises.instructions: Two medium-width overhand sets: about 6 strict reps plus 2 assisted reps to the top. Adjust strict reps to ability.

exercises.name: Chins — wide grip
exercises.instructions: Two wide-grip sets: about 6 strict reps plus 2 spotter-assisted reps. Adjust rep goal (e.g. 8+2 or 5+2) to maintain quality.

exercises.name: Dumbbell pullover
exercises.instructions: Lie along bench with head extending beyond the end, not across it. Lower dumbbell to about forehead level on the way back up, keeping tension in upper lats and serratus. Two sets of 10.

5-4.title: Arms, Calves & Abs
5-4.notes: Arms source heading biceps 14 + triceps 12; reverse curls add 2 biceps sets to the three 4-round supersets. Calves 6 sets (4 seated + 2 standing); abs 8 sets. The source image 5.4 is upside-down and was rotated for review.

exercises.name: Rope pushdowns
exercises.instructions: Superset A with seated incline dumbbell supinated curls. Two warm-up sets of each. Flex hard at bottom of rope pushdown; four rounds.

exercises.name: Seated incline dumbbell supinated curls
exercises.instructions: Superset A. Palms stay up through the full curl; use a 3-second lowering phase. Four rounds.

exercises.name: Bench dips
exercises.instructions: Superset B with standing barbell/EZ curls. Add a plate each set if possible (source suggests 45 lb, but smaller plates are fine). Four rounds.

exercises.name: Standing barbell or EZ-bar curls
exercises.instructions: Superset B. Use the same weight each set, perfect form, squeeze biceps hard at top. Four rounds.

exercises.name: Seated dumbbell triceps extensions
exercises.instructions: Superset C. Lower heavy dumbbell behind head, pause and stretch; rise only three-quarters of the way. Four rounds.

exercises.name: EZ-bar preacher curls
exercises.instructions: Superset C. Lower nearly to full extension, do not fully lock elbows, use a 3-second negative, pause/squeeze one second at top. Four rounds.

exercises.name: Reverse EZ-bar curls
exercises.instructions: Two sets of 12 with bar gripped overhand. Source recommends using a heavier bar, squeezing hard through movement and avoiding wrist strain.

exercises.name: Seated calf raises
exercises.instructions: Two warm-up sets. Four sets of 15, rise and squeeze, stretch fully at bottom. First two with substantial weight; last two can be lighter to allow very deep stretch.

exercises.name: Standing calf raises
exercises.instructions: Two sets of 50 without weight, standing on a step for stretch. Use controlled full motion.

exercises.name: Lower abdominal exercise (choose one)
exercises.instructions: Choose hanging leg raises, elbows-supported leg raises, decline-bench leg raises, or V-ups. Four sets of 15–25 according to difficulty. The displayed 20 reps is a placeholder within that prescribed range; choose actual reps.

exercises.name: Upper abdominal exercise (choose one)
exercises.instructions: Choose incline sit-ups, rope pulldowns/crunches, or band crunches. Four sets of 15–25 according to difficulty. The displayed 20 reps is a placeholder within that prescribed range; choose actual reps.

6-1.title: Legs
6-1.notes: Source heading 16 sets = 6 superset exercise-sets + 4 squats + 3 hacks + 3 deadlifts.

exercises.name: Seated leg curls
exercises.instructions: Pre-exhaust superset with leg extensions; two warm-up rounds, then three working rounds. First 15, second 12, third 8 heavy, with normal form.

exercises.name: Leg extensions
exercises.instructions: Paired with seated curls. First 15, second 12, third 8 followed immediately by 15 short partials at bottom.

exercises.name: Barbell squats
exercises.instructions: Two warm-up sets. Pyramid weight for four hard sets of 8. Three-second controlled descent, then drive up; squat to parallel. Fourth set should be extremely challenging.

exercises.name: Hack squats
exercises.instructions: Three rock-bottom sets of 8, increasing weight if possible. Stretch quads hard for 30 seconds between sets.

exercises.name: Dumbbell stiff-legged deadlifts
exercises.instructions: Three sets of 12, go down deep into hamstring stretch, then come up only three-quarters of the way to retain tension.

6-2.title: Chest & Shoulders
6-2.notes: Source chest 16 sets (4+5+4+3); shoulders 10 (4+3+3). Smith press target reps 10–6 inferred from five-set example, not an explicit fixed prescription.

exercises.name: Hammer Strength incline press
exercises.instructions: Two warm-ups. Pyramid up through 12, 10, 8; focus on deep stretch and continuous tension, pressing only three-quarters up. Fourth set: use weight from 8-rep set, do 8 then drop weight and do 8 more.

exercises.name: Incline Smith machine press
exercises.instructions: Slight incline. Work up through five sets from about 10 to 6 reps, adding ~10–20 lb each set. Lower slowly to 2 inches above upper chest and press to three-quarter lockout. Source lists an example progression of 225×10, 250×9, 275×8, 300×7, 320×6.

exercises.name: Barbell bench press rest-pause clusters
exercises.instructions: Four cluster sets: pause bar on chest for two seconds each rep, then drive up. Within each set do 5 reps, rack for 20 seconds, do 4, rack for 20 seconds, do 3 (12 reps per cluster).

exercises.name: Pec fly machine
exercises.instructions: Three sets of 8, emphasizing stretch and holding a one-second flex at contraction. Between sets, stretch each pec for 30 seconds.

exercises.name: Machine side laterals with negative resistance
exercises.instructions: Three sets of 10 with a partner pushing down on the pads/arms to add eccentric resistance (or use dumbbells with assisted negative). Finish with one set of 50 very small partials out of the bottom.

exercises.name: Wide-grip Smith machine military press
exercises.instructions: Lower bar to forehead, press to lockout and lean slightly forward while flexing delts. Use light-moderate weight, slow negative, rest only ~45 seconds.

exercises.name: High cable rear delts
exercises.instructions: Three sets of 25 on high pulleys at crossover rack. Pull from high angle; use light weight.

6-3.title: Back
6-3.notes: Source heading 17 sets = 4+4+3+3+3. One-arm row starts on page 6.2 and finishes on 6.3.

exercises.name: Smith machine bent-over rows
exercises.instructions: Two warm-ups. Set stops at mid-shin and pause bar for one second on the stops each rep; lower controlled and drive hard, four hard sets of 8.

exercises.name: One-arm barbell rows
exercises.instructions: Landmine-style barbell in a corner; stand beside bar and grip just below plates. Add weight each set if able; eight reps per set, focus on stretch at bottom and lower-lat thickness. Two 30-second lat stretches after this exercise.

exercises.name: Underhand-grip lat pulldowns (Dorian Yates style)
exercises.instructions: Grip a little wider than shoulder width; adjust wrist position for comfort. Drive elbows down, keep chest arched, constant tension, avoid turning into a biceps curl.

exercises.name: Dumbbell pullovers
exercises.instructions: Lie along bench with head hanging off end, not across bench. Get a little extra stretch each rep, emphasizing serratus and upper lats.

exercises.name: Dumbbell hyperextensions
exercises.instructions: Three sets: ten slow weighted reps squeezing spinal erectors at top, then drop dumbbell and pump ten additional bodyweight reps each set.

6-4.title: Arms, Calves & Abs
6-4.notes: Source biceps 14 and triceps 14 (4-round quad set + 3-round quad set); calves 5; abs 8. The source prescribes 15–25 ab reps, and 20 is an editable placeholder.

exercises.name: Rope pushdowns
exercises.instructions: Quad set #1, four rounds. Flex at bottom with hands apart to hit lateral triceps.

exercises.name: Seated dumbbell supination curls
exercises.instructions: Quad set #1. Perform one arm at a time, supinating and flexing hard at top.

exercises.name: High cable kickbacks
exercises.instructions: Quad set #1. Keep upper arm parallel to floor; lock and flex elbow, then raise whole arm about two inches to increase contraction.

exercises.name: EZ-bar reverse curls
exercises.instructions: Quad set #1. Curl to chin and lower with a three-second negative.

exercises.name: Weighted dips
exercises.instructions: Quad set #2, three rounds. Bodyweight is fine. Stay in middle range, not all the way down or all the way up; keep tension.

exercises.name: EZ-bar curls
exercises.instructions: Quad set #2. Regular curls, lower with three-second negative.

exercises.name: Lying triceps extensions
exercises.instructions: Quad set #2. Use manageable weight, allow bar slightly behind head for a long triceps stretch. Stretch each triceps and biceps for 30 seconds after each round.

exercises.name: Dumbbell hammer curls
exercises.instructions: Quad set #2. Curl both arms together, heavy enough to be challenging; squeeze dumbbells tightly. Stretch biceps and triceps 30 seconds after each round.

exercises.name: Standing calf raises
exercises.instructions: One warm-up set of 30. Pyramid to three heavy sets of 10; reduce weight for final set of 20. Flex at top, stretch at bottom for 3 seconds. Finish with 30-second stretch on each calf.

exercises.name: Seated calf raises
exercises.instructions: One all-out extended set: 15 reps, drop weight for 10, drop again for 20 tiny bottom partials. No hold at bottom; keep reps moving.

exercises.name: Lower abdominal exercise (choose one)
exercises.instructions: Choose hanging leg raises, elbows-supported leg raises, decline-bench leg raises, or V-ups. Four sets of 15–25 depending on difficulty; 20 is a placeholder within prescribed range.

exercises.name: Upper abdominal exercise (choose one)
exercises.instructions: Choose incline sit-ups, rope pulldowns/crunches, or band crunches. Four sets of 15–25 depending on difficulty; 20 is a placeholder within prescribed range.

exercises.name: Leg extensions
exercises.instructions:
Warm-up: 3 warm-up sets of leg extensions and seated curls
Superset with seated leg curls. Set 1: hold and squeeze one second at top; set 2 increase weight and repeat; set 3 increase weight and pause/flex two seconds at extension; set 4 start at set-3 weight and increase 3–4 plates for 6 reps, holding the top flex three seconds.
Group: Leg extension + seated curl — 4 supersets

exercises.name: Seated leg curls
exercises.instructions:
Warm-up: 3 warm-up sets paired with leg extensions
Perform immediately after each extension set. Last set use slightly heavier weight for six reps.
Group: Leg extension + seated curl — 4 supersets

exercises.name: Machine leg press (upright selectorized)
exercises.instructions:
Warm-up: 2–3 additional warm-up sets
Deep, shoulder-width foot placement. Set 1: 20 continuous-tension reps. Set 2: increase ~40 lb, 15 standard reps then 5 bottom-rest-pause reps. Set 3: increase weight, 10 standard then 10 bottom-rest-pause reps. Set 4: increase again, 5 standard then 15 rest-pause reps; brief pauses at 10 and 15 permitted. Avoid lockout.

exercises.name: Barbell stiff-leg deadlift
exercises.instructions:
Warm-up: No additional warm-up prescribed
Use small plates for deeper bottom stretch; stand fully upright and flex glutes and hamstrings at top.

exercises.name: Incline dumbbell press
exercises.instructions:
Warm-up: 3 warm-up sets
Slight pyramid; raise weight ~5–10 lb each set. Fourth set use same weight as third for eight reps with spotter assistance for last 2–3 forced reps. Stretch deeply at bottom; return without locking out.

exercises.name: Flat dumbbell press
exercises.instructions:
Warm-up: 1 warm-up set
Lower under control, pause one second at bottom to feel stretch, press and flex at top. Use challenging weight and precise reps.

exercises.name: Smith machine decline press
exercises.instructions: Slight decline; bar touches just below nipple line. Controlled slower-than-normal descent, brief pause near chest, then press just short of lockout; increase load each set.

exercises.name: Machine fly
exercises.instructions: Deep stretch, hold contracted position two seconds.

exercises.name: Heavy partial side lateral raises
exercises.instructions: Heavy partial range, about six inches; head tilted back to reduce trap involvement.

exercises.name: Rear delt dumbbell raises (hang and swings)
exercises.instructions: 20-second breaks. Use rear-delt-focused swinging partials as fatigue increases; do not substitute back/trap swinging.

exercises.name: Smith machine seated military press
exercises.instructions:
Warm-up: 1 warm-up set
Three-second descent to crown of head, press without locking out, continuous tension; select weight estimated for eight good reps and continue until failure.

exercises.name: T-bar rows
exercises.instructions:
Warm-up: 2–3 warm-up sets
Use neutral grip, one-second lowering and hard squeeze at top; pyramid warm-ups until working weight.

exercises.name: Dumbbell rows
exercises.instructions: Regular rows (not dead-stop). Stretch lower lats at bottom; slightly raise hip on working side to increase stretch.

exercises.name: Barbell shrugs
exercises.instructions:
Paired with dumbbell pullovers. Source introductory line says dumbbell shrugs, but the actual instruction explicitly specifies a barbell.
Group: Barbell shrugs + dumbbell pullovers — 4 supersets

exercises.name: Dumbbell pullovers
exercises.instructions:
Lie along the bench, not across it.
Group: Barbell shrugs + dumbbell pullovers — 4 supersets

exercises.name: Rack pulls
exercises.instructions: Pyramid to heavy working weight; lower slowly to mid-shin pins and reset, drive up powerfully, elbows back at top to engage lower lats.

exercises.name: Standing alternating dumbbell curls
exercises.instructions:
Warm-up: 2 warm-up sets of 20 dumbbell curls
Eight reps per arm, supinate during ascent and squeeze. Pair with EZ-bar curls; one-minute rest between rounds.
Group: Dumbbell curls + EZ-bar curls — 4 supersets

exercises.name: EZ-bar curls
exercises.instructions:
Warm-up: 2 warm-up sets of 8
Moderate weight, three-second eccentric per rep.
Group: Dumbbell curls + EZ-bar curls — 4 supersets

exercises.name: One-arm dumbbell preacher curls
exercises.instructions: Switch arms; 30 seconds between sets. Let arm reach full safe extension, hold stretch one second; use steep incline bench.

exercises.name: Reverse curls
exercises.instructions: After each set put weight down and count 20 before the next descending-rep set.

exercises.name: Bent-over rope triceps extensions
exercises.instructions:
Warm-up: 2 warm-up sets of 20
Lean forward with back supported on pad; allow wrists to travel behind head for full triceps stretch.

exercises.name: Seated dip machine
exercises.instructions: Pyramid heavier until eight reps become difficult; controlled continuous tension, avoid lockout and jerking, allow stretch. Substitute weighted bench dips if machine unavailable.

exercises.name: Smith machine close-grip JM-style press
exercises.instructions: Slight incline; grip just inside shoulder width. Lower slowly toward chin with elbows moving out, pause one second at bottom, press without full lockout.

exercises.name: Smith machine standing calf raises
exercises.instructions:
Warm-up: 1 warm-up set of 20
One warm-up set of 20. Set 1 hard 15 with two-second stretched bottom; sets 2–3 increase load, do partials from stretch if needed to finish 15; set 4 return to set-2 load; set 5 reduce to set-1 load. Repeat entire five-set calf session twice this week.

exercises.name: Lower abs — choose one exercise
exercises.instructions: Choose hanging leg raises, supported elbow-pad leg raises, decline bench leg raises, or V-ups. Repeat abs workout twice weekly.

exercises.name: Upper abs — choose one exercise
exercises.instructions: Choose incline sit-ups, rope crunches/pulldowns, or band crunches. Repeat abs workout twice weekly.

exercises.name: Seated leg curls
exercises.instructions:
Warm-up: 2 warm-up sets of 15
Each rep begins from straightened legs; squeeze hard, bring feet back as far as possible, then lower slowly. Every rep has a rest-pause.

exercises.name: Leg press
exercises.instructions:
Warm-up: 2–3 warm-up sets
Superset with dumbbell stiff-leg deadlifts. Increase load each round. Shoulder-width feet, moderate depth, pump repetitions and no lockout; rest ~3 minutes between supersets.
Group: Leg press + dumbbell stiff-leg deadlift — 5 supersets
exercises.group: Leg press + dumbbell stiff-leg deadlift — 5 supersets

exercises.name: Dumbbell stiff-leg deadlift
exercises.instructions:
Warm-up: 1 warm-up set
Moderate load, hamstring constant tension; do not fully stand and lock out. Immediately follows leg press.
Group: Leg press + dumbbell stiff-leg deadlift — 5 supersets
exercises.group: Leg press + dumbbell stiff-leg deadlift — 5 supersets

exercises.name: Hack squats
exercises.instructions:
High, wide foot stance with toes turned out; increase weight each set, descend deep but stop short of lockout. Pair each set with six more dumbbell stiff-leg deadlifts. Stretch quads 30 seconds before and 45 seconds after this block.
Group: Hack squat + dumbbell stiff-leg deadlift — 3 supersets
exercises.group: Hack squat + dumbbell stiff-leg deadlift — 3 supersets

exercises.name: Dumbbell stiff-leg deadlift (after hack squats)
exercises.instructions:
Repeat six controlled stiff-leg deadlifts after each hack squat set.
Group: Hack squat + dumbbell stiff-leg deadlift — 3 supersets
exercises.group: Hack squat + dumbbell stiff-leg deadlift — 3 supersets

exercises.name: Hammer incline press

sets.reps: failure + drop to failure + drop to 3 partials
failure + drop to failure + drop to 3 partials

exercises.instructions:
Warm-up: 2 warm-up sets
Source describes pyramiding sets of eight to a weight that cannot be repeated for eight with additional load; then a continuous-tension drop set with two reductions, ending with three partials from stretched bottom. Exact counting of 3 work sets is ambiguous; record as 3 work sets with the drop sequence on the final effort. Stretch pecs for 30 seconds after.

exercises.name: Incline dumbbell press
exercises.instructions:
Warm-up: 1 weight-finding set
Choose challenging eight-rep weight; deep bottom stretch and no lockout.

exercises.name: Barbell incline press
exercises.instructions: Already pre-exhausted; four sets of five, continuous tension without locking out.

exercises.name: Machine fly
exercises.instructions: First hard 10 with two-second squeeze at contraction; rest 30 seconds, drop weight 3–4 plates for 10; rest 30 seconds, repeat 10 with same reduced load. Spotter assists full contraction as needed. Stretch pecs 45 seconds afterward.

exercises.name: Dumbbell side laterals
exercises.instructions: Two sets of 25 followed by two heavy sets of eight.

exercises.name: Bent-over dumbbell side laterals
exercises.instructions: Two sets of 35 followed by two heavy sets of ten.

exercises.name: 6-ways shoulder raises
exercises.instructions: Each rep: seated lateral raise to ear height, bring dumbbells together in front, raise overhead and flex front delts one second, lower in front, reverse to sides, then lower arms. Use light dumbbells.

exercises.name: Front pulldowns
exercises.instructions:
Warm-up: 2 warm-up sets of 10
Pyramid each set; arch chest, hold strong one-second contraction at bottom, maximize safe stretch at top.

exercises.name: Dumbbell dead-stop rows
exercises.instructions: Rest dumbbell on floor between each repetition; pull explosively without sloppy form.

exercises.name: Low cable rows
exercises.instructions: Stay upright, squeeze lower lats hard; use challenging weight that remains controlled.

exercises.name: Chest-supported rows
exercises.instructions: Chest against pad; elbows high to target rhomboids/midback, pull back fully and lower to ~80% range, keeping tension.

exercises.name: Dumbbell shrugs
exercises.instructions: Continuous tension, no holds at top; 30-second breaks.

exercises.name: Hyperextensions
exercises.instructions: First set weighted to failure then drop load for additional reps. Second set use half weight and repeat to failure. Third set bodyweight for maximum reps. Exact rep targets intentionally variable.

exercises.name: Standing dumbbell curls
exercises.instructions:
Warm-up: 2 warm-up sets of 8
Three-second eccentric; pronate wrists at bottom, return to supinated grip as you curl.

exercises.name: Wide-grip EZ-bar preacher curls
exercises.instructions: Do not extend all the way down; flex at top and lower three-quarters of the way.

exercises.name: EZ-bar reverse curls
exercises.instructions: Each set: 10 full-range curls followed by 10 half-range curls to 90-degree elbow position.

exercises.name: Barbell curls (rest-pause cluster)
exercises.instructions: Source prescribes 10 reps, rest 20 seconds, 8 reps, rest 20 seconds, 6 reps, and labels three total work sets; represented as three stages with original ambiguity flagged.

exercises.name: Rope pushdowns
exercises.instructions:
Warm-up: 2 warm-up sets of 15
For each set squeeze/flex first 15 reps, then pump remaining 10 without hard flex.

exercises.name: Weighted dips between benches
exercises.instructions: Add weight on lap; descend deeply, stop just short of elbow discomfort.

exercises.name: EZ-bar close-grip bench press
exercises.instructions: Two-second eccentric, pause at bottom for triceps stretch, drive upward and flex; bar may stop 4–5 inches above chest.

exercises.name: Seated calf raises
exercises.instructions:
Warm-up: 2 warm-up sets of 15
Superset with donkey calf raises; deep stretch at bottom.
Group: Seated calf raises + donkey calf raises — 5 supersets
exercises.group: Seated calf raises + donkey calf raises — 5 supersets

exercises.name: Donkey calf raises
exercises.instructions:
Rise all the way onto toes and flex; stretch calves hard 20 seconds between each superset.
Group: Seated calf raises + donkey calf raises — 5 supersets
exercises.group: Seated calf raises + donkey calf raises — 5 supersets

exercises.name: Lower abs — choose one exercise
exercises.instructions: Choose hanging leg raises, supported elbow-pad leg raises, decline bench leg raises, or V-ups.

exercises.name: Upper abs — choose one exercise
exercises.instructions: Choose incline sit-ups, rope crunches/pulldowns, or band crunches.

exercises.name: Barbell stiff-legged deadlifts
exercises.instructions:
Warm-up: 2–3 warm-up sets
Slight knee bend at bottom; progressively add weight until 10 challenging reps; rise only three-quarters to maintain hamstring tension.

exercises.name: Leg press
exercises.instructions:
Warm-up: As many ramp-up sets of 10 as needed
Feet high and relatively narrow; warm up with sets of 10 until no longer able to get 10; then 4 sets of 8. Lower three-quarters, avoid bottom and lockout, constant tension.

exercises.name: Leg extension
exercises.instructions: Sit toward front of seat and lean forward; short range, kick and flex. Increase load each set; last set to failure (source example 37 reps).

exercises.name: Hack squat
exercises.instructions: Three-second eccentric, one-second pause at bottom, then drive up. Deep paused reps with moderate load.

exercises.name: Lying leg curl
exercises.instructions: Perfect form; no additional warm-up needed.

exercises.name: Hammer Strength incline press
exercises.instructions:
Warm-up: 2 warm-up sets
Seat low, push upward; arch chest for stretch. Last set eight full reps followed by 25 short bottom-range partials.

exercises.name: Incline barbell press
exercises.instructions:
Warm-up: 1 warm-up set
One warm-up set, then use a weight normally good for ~15 reps. Drive up explosively; lower slowly; pause for a split second at bottom. Not to failure.

exercises.name: Flat dumbbell press
exercises.instructions: Pause at bottom and squeeze for one second at top; use a lighter weight than normal.

exercises.name: Decline Smith-machine bench press
exercises.instructions:
Warm-up: No specific warm-up prescribed
Choose a weight usually good for 15 normal reps; perform paused reps to failure. Add weight for second set; source suggests ~3–4 reps.

exercises.name: Single-arm cable side lateral raise
exercises.instructions: 20 each arm; raise slightly above head height with strict form and little weight; only 30 seconds rest between sets.

exercises.name: One-arm bent-over dumbbell rear lateral
exercises.instructions: Cross arm in front of body for stretch then sweep outward; flex rear delt and stop momentum.

exercises.name: Seated dumbbell shoulder press
exercises.instructions: Heavy; lower to ear level, drive up near lockout, then lower without resting.

exercises.name: Seated close-grip cable row
exercises.instructions:
Warm-up: 2 warm-up sets of 10
Superset with neutral-grip pulldown. First two rounds: hold contraction each rep. Final two: heavier, stretch forward and do not pause contraction.
Group: Superset A — 4 rounds

exercises.name: Neutral-grip pulldown
exercises.instructions:
Warm-up: 1 warm-up set
First two rounds: heavy, stretch fully at top, no bottom hold. Last two: lighten and hold bottom contraction one second.
Group: Superset A — 4 rounds

exercises.name: Dead-stop dumbbell row
exercises.instructions: Heavy; fully stop and rest dumbbell at bottom, then drive elbow upward.

exercises.name: Barbell shrug
exercises.instructions:
Pyramid up; hold and flex each rep at top for two seconds. Between sets hang from chin-up bar for 30 seconds.
Group: Paired with 30-second lat hangs

exercises.name: Good morning
exercises.instructions: Very slow and controlled; maintain back arch throughout.

exercises.name: Standing dumbbell curl to hammer curl
exercises.instructions:
Warm-up: 2 warm-up sets of 15 dumbbell curls
Both arms simultaneously; lower regular curls over three seconds, then rotate to hammer grip for six more. Immediately machine curl.
Group: Biceps superset A — 4 rounds

exercises.name: Machine biceps curl
exercises.instructions:
Warm-up: 1 warm-up set of 15
Flex six strict reps after standing dumbbell/hammer curls.
Group: Biceps superset A — 4 rounds

exercises.name: Standing EZ-bar curl
exercises.instructions:
Eight reps, then immediately one-arm preacher curls.
Group: Biceps superset B — 3 rounds

exercises.name: One-arm dumbbell preacher curl
exercises.instructions:
Lower to stretch; rotate thumb down near bottom, supinate on ascent. Eight per arm.
Group: Biceps superset B — 3 rounds

exercises.name: Rope triceps pushdown
exercises.instructions: Thirty-second rests; squeeze each rep as well as possible.

exercises.name: Close-grip EZ-bar bench press
exercises.instructions: Three-second eccentric, pause at bottom, drive up. Keep bar toward nose rather than chest; pyramid load.

exercises.name: Seated overhead rope triceps extension on low pulley
exercises.instructions: Seated with back support facing away from low pulley; deep stretch each rep; partner can hand rope over.

exercises.name: Leg-press toe presses
exercises.instructions: Use light plates; press continuously 60 seconds, rest 60 seconds. Repeat this four-set workout twice during the week (8 weekly sets).

exercises.name: Lower-ab exercise — choose one
exercises.instructions:
Choose lower abs: hanging leg raises, supported leg raises, decline bench leg raises, or V-ups. Choose upper abs: incline sit-ups, rope crunches, or band crunches. Perform 4 sets of each, twice weekly; reps adjusted to difficulty.
Group: Abs circuit — twice weekly

exercises.name: Upper-ab exercise — choose one
exercises.instructions:
Choose lower abs: hanging leg raises, supported leg raises, decline bench leg raises, or V-ups. Choose upper abs: incline sit-ups, rope crunches, or band crunches. Perform 4 sets of each, twice weekly; reps adjusted to difficulty.
Group: Abs circuit — twice weekly

exercises.name: Lying leg curl — 1¼ reps
exercises.instructions:
Warm-up: 3 warm-up sets of 10
One rep is full ROM plus quarter rep at stretched bottom. Pause for one second at bottom, do not bounce. Add weight after first set.

exercises.name: Leg press — high narrow stance
exercises.instructions:
Warm-up: Ramp-up sets of 15
Ramp with sets of 15. Three working sets; final set is a double drop set totaling 45 reps. Short piston-like reps, no lockout or pad contact.

exercises.name: Hack squat — low close stance
exercises.instructions: Feet lower and together; go deep, rise only halfway. Increase weight each set. Afterward do two 30-second quad stretches per leg.

exercises.name: Smith-machine squat
exercises.instructions:
Warm-up: Optional low-rep warm-ups
Heavy, fairly wide with toes out; descend for three seconds, to just above parallel.

exercises.name: Barbell stiff-legged deadlift
exercises.instructions: Emphasize top half, stand tall and squeeze glutes and hamstrings.

exercises.name: Incline dumbbell press
exercises.instructions:
Warm-up: 2–3 warm-up sets of 15
Pyramid up; third working set should barely reach ten. Stretch at bottom, flex at top.

exercises.name: Flat dumbbell press
exercises.instructions: Strict form, deep stretch, pause, press and flex. Last set includes four small top-range chest flexes.

exercises.name: Machine fly
exercises.instructions: Flex throughout ROM; partner assists five additional reps after ten on each set.

exercises.name: Decline Smith-machine bench press
exercises.instructions: Lower to chest, press to three-quarter lockout. Last set: six, substantial weight drop for ten, another drop and wider grip to failure.

exercises.name: Heavy dumbbell side lateral raise
exercises.instructions:
Slow negative, then immediately rear-delt hang and swings.
Group: Shoulder superset — 2 rounds

exercises.name: Rear-delt hang and swings
exercises.instructions:
Face down on incline bench; swing arms to target rear delts. Fifty reps per round.
Group: Shoulder superset — 2 rounds

exercises.name: Machine rear-delt fly
exercises.instructions: Flex hard in contracted position; lighten weight for final 35-rep burnout.

exercises.name: Barbell over-and-backs
exercises.instructions: Light barbell; move from front just over head to behind and back without dropping low behind head. One front-to-back-and-return cycle equals one rep.

exercises.name: Single-arm low cable row
exercises.instructions:
Warm-up: 2 warm-up sets of 12
Reach forward to stretch lower lats; sit up, arch, pull elbow back. Pyramid weight slightly.

exercises.name: Smith-machine bent-over rest-pause row
exercises.instructions: Set pins slightly above mid-shin; control descent, pause on catches, drive up hard; add weight after two sets.

exercises.name: Dumbbell pullover
exercises.instructions: Lie lengthwise on bench with head over end; gradually deepen stretch.

exercises.name: Half-rep chin-up
exercises.instructions: Stretch at bottom, pull only halfway while keeping chest arched. Spotter can assist near end.

exercises.name: Dumbbell shrug
exercises.instructions: Pump 35 reps with one minute rest.

exercises.name: Weighted hyperextension drop set

sets.reps: weighted to failure + bodyweight to failure
weighted to failure + bodyweight to failure
weighted to failure + bodyweight to failure

exercises.instructions: Slow weighted reps to failure, then immediately drop dumbbell and continue unweighted to failure.

exercises.name: Seated dumbbell curl
exercises.instructions:
Warm-up: 3 sets of 10 to warm up
Palms up throughout; two-second eccentric, hard top squeeze. Immediately EZ preacher curls.
Group: Biceps superset A — 3 rounds, 90s rest

exercises.name: EZ-bar preacher curl
exercises.instructions:
Two-second negative, hard top squeeze.
Group: Biceps superset A — 3 rounds, 90s rest

exercises.name: EZ-bar reverse curl
exercises.instructions:
Lift to forearms perpendicular to floor; squeeze bar hard.
Group: Biceps superset B — 3 rounds, 90s rest

exercises.name: Dumbbell hammer preacher curl
exercises.instructions:
One arm at a time, full stretch and full contraction.
Group: Biceps superset B — 3 rounds, 90s rest

exercises.name: Bench dip
exercises.instructions:
Warm-up: Pushdown warm-ups as needed
Back supported, feet elevated; do as many as possible up to 40, then overhead extension.
Group: Triceps superset — 3 rounds

exercises.name: Overhead dumbbell extension — bottom quarter
exercises.instructions:
Only bottom quarter ROM to load stretch after bench dips; controlled reps.
Group: Triceps superset — 3 rounds

exercises.name: Straight-bar triceps pushdown
exercises.instructions: Heavy, strict form; allow bar to rise high for lower-triceps stretch.

exercises.name: Standing calf raise
exercises.instructions: Pyramid to heavy load; 45 seconds rest. Perform six-set workout twice weekly (12 weekly sets).

exercises.name: Lower-ab exercise — choose one
exercises.instructions:
Choose lower abs: hanging leg raises, supported leg raises, decline bench leg raises, or V-ups. Choose upper abs: incline sit-ups, rope crunches, or band crunches. Perform 4 sets of each, twice weekly; reps adjusted to difficulty.
Group: Abs circuit — twice weekly

exercises.name: Upper-ab exercise — choose one
exercises.instructions:
Choose lower abs: hanging leg raises, supported leg raises, decline bench leg raises, or V-ups. Choose upper abs: incline sit-ups, rope crunches, or band crunches. Perform 4 sets of each, twice weekly; reps adjusted to difficulty.
Group: Abs circuit — twice weekly

exercises.name: Leg extensions
exercises.instructions:
Warm-up: 2–3 warm-up sets of 15 for both movements
Perform 8 reps, partner performs 8, immediately perform another 8. Then move to leg curls after enough recovery. Three rounds paired with curls; 6 total working sets across the pair.
Group: Superset with lying leg curls — 3 rounds
exercises.group: Superset with lying leg curls — 3 rounds

exercises.name: Lying leg curls
exercises.instructions:
Warm-up: 2–3 warm-up sets of 15
Perform 10 reps, partner performs 10, then immediately another 10; repeat in three rounds with leg extensions. Not every rep must be maximum intensity.
Group: Superset with leg extensions — 3 rounds

exercises.name: Smith machine squats
exercises.instructions: Lower for 3 seconds on each rep. Do 6 reps, partner does 6, then do 6 more for one working set. Gradually pyramid weight upward over 5 double-sets.

exercises.name: Flye machine
exercises.instructions:
Warm-up: 2 warm-up sets of 15
Flex at top for one second on each rep; after rep 10, hold the squeeze for 10 seconds.

exercises.name: Incline barbell Smith machine press
exercises.instructions: Use a very slight incline and continuous tension: no lockout, stop about 2 inches short of chest. Set 1: 25 reps; set 2: add weight for 15 hard reps; set 3: choose weight for about 8 reps, rack, count to 20, perform 4 more, rack and count to 20, then perform 22 reps as printed in source. The last number may be a source typo; verify before training.

exercises.name: Flat dumbbell press
exercises.instructions: Elevate one end of bench on top of 25 lb plates for very slight incline. Rest-pause every rep: lower, pause at bottom, stretch, drive up and flex one second at top.

exercises.name: Decline dumbbell press
exercises.instructions: Use a slight decline, not steep. Set up with a partner if possible; lower for a deep stretch without pausing or flexing at top. Press to about three-quarters lockout.

exercises.name: Cable side laterals
exercises.instructions: One arm at a time. Stand away from cable machine so starting hand crosses the body; raise through full range. 20 reps per arm each set.

exercises.name: Machine rear laterals
exercises.instructions: Reverse pec deck. Hold and flex for one second at peak of every rep.

exercises.name: Seated dumbbell press
exercises.instructions: Strict form; control the weight, no sloppy repetitions. Optional one-second flex at top.

exercises.name: Front pulldowns
exercises.instructions:
Warm-up: 2 warm-up sets of 15
Very wide grip at ends of pulldown bar. Pull to chin and allow bar to rise fully. Relax upper body at top to stretch scapulae; shoulders may feel tight initially.

exercises.name: Low cable rows
exercises.instructions: Increase weight each set. Lean forward about 10 degrees on return; arch chest and squeeze for half a second at top.

exercises.name: Smith machine bent-over rows
exercises.instructions: Pyramid heavier each set. No rest-pause this week. Control the weight and drive elbows rather than pulling with biceps.

exercises.name: Hyperextensions
exercises.instructions: Three sets of as many reps as possible; source gives a 47-rep first-set benchmark.

exercises.name: Seated dumbbell supinated curls + hammer curls
exercises.instructions:
Warm-up: 2 warm-up sets of 15
Sit against a backrest. Perform 6 supinated reps with both arms together and 3-second negatives, then turn palms neutral for 6 hammer curls. Straighten arms fully before each hammer rep.

exercises.name: Close-grip chin-ups
exercises.instructions: Keep back from arching and focus on biceps. If fewer than six reps, ask spotter for 2–4 assisted reps.

exercises.name: EZ-bar reverse-grip curls
exercises.instructions: Raise bar all the way to face and lower slowly; forearms and brachialis emphasis.

exercises.name: Rope pushdowns
exercises.instructions:
Warm-up: 2 warm-up sets of 25
Fairly heavy; straighten arms and flex each rep.

exercises.name: Reverse-grip pushdowns
exercises.instructions: Use one arm at a time (preferred) or both hands on straight bar; flex at bottom.

exercises.name: Bench dips
exercises.instructions: Try added weight on lap; descend progressively deeper for a triceps stretch near elbow.

exercises.name: Standing calf raises
exercises.instructions: Pyramid to heavy weight. Stretch fully at bottom; drive up and flex. Rest 60 seconds between sets. Do this calf workout once this week.

exercises.name: Lower abdominal exercise — choose one
exercises.instructions: Choose hanging leg raises, elbow-supported leg raises, decline-bench leg raises, or V-ups. Perform 4 sets per abdominal workout, twice this week.

exercises.name: Upper abdominal exercise — choose one
exercises.instructions: Choose incline sit-ups, rope crunches, or band crunches. Perform 4 sets per abdominal workout, twice this week.

exercises.name: Seated leg curls
exercises.instructions:
Warm-up: 3 warm-up sets of 12
Rest-pause every rep: extend, pause, flex and squeeze. First two working sets hard but normal. On third set, do 10 reps, add weight and do 10 more, then keep same weight and perform 25 partial reps from the bottom.

exercises.name: Leg press
exercises.instructions:
Warm-up: Ramp-up sets of 10
Warm up in sets of 10 adding weight until 10 reps is difficult. Then perform four working sets of 8, resting only 90 seconds between sets.

exercises.name: Squats
exercises.instructions:
Warm-up: 2–3 ramp-up sets
Work up over 2–3 warm-up sets to a weight normally possible for 12–15 reps. Perform 3 explosive sets of 8 with plenty of rest; avoid grinding.

exercises.name: Neutral-grip machine press
exercises.instructions:
Warm-up: 2 warm-up sets of 15 with flex
Palms facing one another, elbows travel close to sides. Alternative Hammer Strength press if neutral grip unavailable. Pyramid weight; flex at top for one second each rep.

exercises.name: Incline barbell press
exercises.instructions: Lower to 2–3 inches above chest, no lockout; constant tension.

exercises.name: Decline Smith machine press
exercises.instructions: Very slight decline. Touch chest at bottom; press to three-quarters lockout with continuous tension. Two high-rep sets followed by heavier set of 8.

exercises.name: Dumbbell side laterals
exercises.instructions: Two high-repetition sets.

exercises.name: Cage press
exercises.instructions: Perform five sets of five explosively; source references an instructional video for form.

exercises.name: Machine rear delts
exercises.instructions: Reverse pec deck; high-repetition rear-delt sets.

exercises.name: Wide-grip front pulldowns
exercises.instructions:
Warm-up: 2 warm-up sets of 15
Grip as wide as possible, pull only to eye level. Heavy weight; relax scapulae at top for a full stretch.

exercises.name: Regular T-bar rows
exercises.instructions: Neutral grip with palms facing each other. Pyramid weight heavier; pull fully to stomach, no half reps.

exercises.name: Dumbbell rows
exercises.instructions: Heavy dumbbells; let arm hang and scapula relax for lat stretch at bottom, then row up.

exercises.name: Dumbbell pullovers
exercises.instructions: Three sets of 12.

exercises.name: EZ-bar curls — 1½ reps
exercises.instructions:
Warm-up: 2 warm-up sets of 15
One full curl, then a half curl up and back down counts as one repetition.

exercises.name: Dumbbell hammer curls on preacher bench
exercises.instructions: One arm at a time. Hard squeeze at top and full lower-biceps stretch at bottom.

exercises.name: EZ-bar preacher curls
exercises.instructions:
Perform 8 hard preacher reps, then immediately 12 reverse curls with same weight. Two supersets.
Group: Superset with reverse curls — 2 rounds

exercises.name: Reverse curls
exercises.instructions:
Immediately after each EZ-bar preacher set, stand and perform 12 reverse curls with same weight.
Group: Superset with EZ-bar preacher curls — 2 rounds
exercises.group: Superset with EZ-bar preacher curls — 2 rounds

exercises.name: EZ-bar close-grip bench press
exercises.instructions:
Warm-up: 2–3 warm-up sets of 10
Perform 3 sets of 8; between each set perform rope pushdowns as a superset.
Group: Superset with rope pushdowns — 3 rounds

exercises.name: Rope pushdowns
exercises.instructions:
Immediately following close-grip bench sets. Hold each repetition at bottom for 3 seconds.
Group: Superset with EZ-bar close-grip bench press — 3 rounds
exercises.group: Superset with EZ-bar close-grip bench press — 3 rounds

exercises.name: Seated dip machine
exercises.instructions: Keep elbows tucked. Come up slowly; stretch lower triceps near elbow and flex each rep for 2 seconds.

exercises.name: Dumbbell lying extensions / skullcrushers
exercises.instructions: Let dumbbells descend to either side of head for triceps stretch; kick upward to above forehead. Hanging head off bench may help stretch.

exercises.name: Toe presses on leg press
exercises.instructions: Three timed sets: as many reps as possible in 60 seconds each. Repeat calf session three times during week (9 weekly sets).

exercises.name: Lower abdominal exercise — choose one
exercises.instructions: Choose hanging leg raises, elbow-supported leg raises, decline-bench leg raises, or V-ups.

exercises.name: Upper abdominal exercise — choose one
exercises.instructions: Choose incline sit-ups, rope crunches, or band crunches.
